settings.headline: Pick by area, not by laser type.
settings.body: Laser appointments vary too widely for a single recommendation. A short underarm session and a full-face fractional resurfacing aren't the same booking. The framework that holds: Advanced Strength suits most laser appointments. Cream is right for face and smaller zones. Spray covers ground for body and larger areas. Professional Strength sits at the top for full-face resurfacing or the most intensive sessions. The treatment area decides — not the laser brand or the clinic's marketing.
settings.image_alt: Editorial product close-up of Senseless Advanced Strength cream

settings.headline: Cream for face. Spray for body.
settings.body: Face laser appointments are precise and contained. Cream is the natural format — a focused application, a controlled area, the format aesthetic clinics work with most often. Body laser work covers larger zones. Spray is built for that — broader coverage, faster application, the format that matches the surface area.

settings.headline: The products built for laser appointments.
settings.body: Advanced Strength for most sessions. Cream for face, spray for body. Professional for full-face resurfacing.

settings.headline: Laser asks specific things from your preparation.
settings.body: Some lasers heat the skin. Some target pigment. Some resurface the top layer. Different lasers ask different things from the preparation that comes before them. Senseless is formulated for the category broadly, with three strengths and two relevant formats to match the appointment you've actually booked.

settings.headline: What comes next.
settings.body: Most aesthetic appointments end with a treated area that needs gentle handling. The Senseless Foaming Cleanser is built for the hours after. An antibacterial cleansing foam that respects what you just had done.

settings.question: Does laser hair removal hurt?
settings.answer: The experience varies — by laser type, by treatment area, by skin sensitivity, by hair coarseness. Many clients find prepared skin more comfortable than unprepared. Read more in our does laser hair removal hurt guide.

settings.question: Which strength is best for laser?
settings.answer: Advanced Strength for most laser appointments. Professional for full-face resurfacing or the most intensive sessions. The treatment area is the deciding factor more than the laser type.

settings.question: Cream or spray for laser?
settings.answer: Cream for face and precise areas. Spray for body and larger zones. The format is decided by surface area, not by personal preference.

settings.question: When do I apply it?
settings.answer: Ahead of your appointment. Specific timing depends on your practitioner's protocol and the type of laser they're using.

settings.question: Can I use Senseless before IPL?
settings.answer: Yes — IPL is part of the laser category Senseless is formulated for. Follow your practitioner's specific guidance.

settings.question: Is this a medicine?
settings.answer: No. Senseless is a UK cosmetic product. Not a medicine. Not a pharmacy product.
